body:
## Context
Consolidate duplicated helpers across ADLC packages per `.adlc/specs/adlc-wave3-consolidation.md`:
1. `W3-T1`: Re-export `readVerdictSource` and delegate `recordVerdict` to `recordPromptOnlyVerdict` from `@adlc/core` in `coldstart`, `premortem`, and `parallax`.
2. `W3-T2`: Promote shared inflight crash-recovery (`probeOwner`, `ownerStateFor`, `isContainedRelPath`, `resolveTarget`, `makeTempPath`, `writeInflightAtomic`, `sweepStaleTemps`, `clearRecord`) and Jaccard Union-Find clustering (`BASE_STOPWORDS`, `jaccard`, `clusterByTokenSets`) primitives to `@adlc/core`, and adopt clustering primitives in `lesson-foundry` and `rejection-mining`.
3. `W3-T3`: Adopt shared inflight and symlink-following atomic write primitives from `@adlc/core` in `hollow-test`, `review-calibration`, and `consensus-fix`.
4. `W3-T4`: Extract duplicated P5/P6 evidence integrity helpers into `packages/runner/lib/p5-evidence.mjs` and adopt in `packages/runner/lib/acceptance.mjs` and `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 9 acceptance criteria in `.adlc/specs/adlc-wave3-consolidation.md` pass.
- Verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/prompt-only-usage.test.mjs packages/premortem/test/prompt-only-usage.test.mjs packages/parallax/test/prompt-only-usage.test.mjs packages/core/test/wave3-primitives.test.mjs packages/core/test/types.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/cluster.test.mjs packages/rejection-mining/test/cluster.test.mjs packages/hollow-test/test/inflight.test.mjs packages/review-calibration/test/inflight-restore.test.mjs packages/consensus-fix/test/snapshot.test.mjs packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs packages/runner/test/p5-evidence.test.mjs`
title: refactor(adlc): Wave 3 cross-package consolidation of verdict, inflight, clustering, and runner P5/P6 helpers
